# Fixture template (contract C2 shape, for tests only)

Prose the parser ignores. A line like `notakey: x` outside the header markers is not a key.

<!-- header -->
session: <full session id>
previous: <previous session id or none>
transcript: <absolute path>
created: <local ISO time with offset>
<!-- /header -->

## 1. Active goal and role
*The goal.*

## 2. User decisions and constraints, verbatim, dated
*Quotes.*

## 3. Pending, owned by the user
*Items.*

## 4. In flight
*Agents.*

## 5. Identifiers the next context must type
*Ids.*

## 6. Last outgoing instruction
*What was sent.*

## 7. Do not redo
*Settled.*

## 8. Last request and status
*One Status line.*

## 9. Dead ends
*Failures.*

## 10. Assumptions to verify
*Checks.*
